techniques.evidence: src/app/api/checklist/complete/route.ts:71 An unmeasured cost is recorded as zero and averaged over every trial, failed ones included (see src/lib/prompt-evolution/ab-testing.ts:79). The cost comparison is not conditioned on outcome, and incomplete measurements are not marked.
src/app/api/checklist/complete/route.ts:64 A trial is booked only for the variant the run was actually served. Static or unserved runs are not counted as trials of an arm.
